user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join population attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the ACS total population attributes to the census tract polygons using runtime-grounded schema keys.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the known census tract vector with the known ACS attribute table. Ground the vector and table join keys from runtime schema evidence; do not assume or rename field names. Preserve one output feature per census tract.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate population and land area by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested per-census-tract total population and geometry-derived land area while retaining tract identifiers and joined attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Aggregate the joined census tract layer at the census-tract feature/unit level. Compute total population from the runtime-grounded joined population field and calculate each tract's land area from its valid polygon geometry. Preserve tract identifiers and output one record per census tract.

requirements.scope: task_attribute_join_population_to_tracts input artifacts must contain a common tract identifier and the ACS total population field.
task_attribute_join_population_to_tracts inputs must use formats supported for GeoPackage vector and CSV attribute-table joining.
task_aggregate_population_and_land_area_by_tract input must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometry for land-area calculation.
task_aggregate_population_and_land_area_by_tract input must retain an identified CRS so the reported land-area units are interpretable.
